title: Review-thread and CI remediation loop
objective: Classify review feedback and CI failures, automatically handle only straightforward bounded fixes, and leave design or ambiguous threads for user/reviewer input.
input: N14 open PR and self-review gates
acceptance_criteria: Simple review requests are fixed on existing branch and tests/self-review rerun.
Only addressed, verified simple threads are resolved.
Code failures retry at most two times; transient external failures at most three; permission/config failures ask user.
undo_classification: Keep unresolved threads and evidence; never auto-merge or close PRs.
approval_requirements: Explicit user approval for architecture/business/requirements changes.
retry_policy: Bounded by failure class; identical failures stop early.
